question: Which equipment is mainly used in military submarines?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Periscope**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Periscope: 

 
 
• Periscope__ is the instrument used in submarines to view objects above sea level.
 
• It is an optical instrument, uses mirrors at 45° angle to observe over, around, and through which is prevented by the line of sight.
 
 

__
 
• It works based on laws of reflection of light.
 
• It is used in submarines to view the upper surface sight, hiding positions for military, nuclear reactor and many other ways

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5db0276ab847c0a4116792d3c43d897a7d970dc8e5ed799530bb777cf20aae6.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Microscope:**

 
 
• A microscope** is an optical instrument used to magnify and observe small objects or structures that are too tiny to be seen by the naked eye**.
 
• It uses lenses or a combination of lenses to achieve high magnification.
 
• **Example Uses**: Studying cells, bacteria, or microscopic organisms in biology or medical labs.
 
 
 
• **Endoscope**:
 
 
• An **endoscope is a medical instrument used to examin**e the interior of a body cavity or a hollow organ.
 
• It c**onsists of a long, flexible or rigid tube with a light source and camera attached to it.**
 
• **Example Uses: **Diagnosing and performing procedures in the gastrointestinal tract, respiratory tract, or joints (e.g., endoscopy, colonoscopy).
 
 
 
• **Telescope:**
 
 
• A t**elescope is an optical instrument designed to observe distant objects by collecting and magnifying light or other electromagnetic radiation.**
 
• It is primarily used in astronomy for viewing celestial bodies.
 
• **Example Uses: **Observing planets, stars, and galaxies.
